cli: lpm aish consumption record --file <receipt.json> [--transport rest|mcp] [--json] (queues in a local outbox; 'lpm aish consumption flush' retries); also lpm aish command record_aish_consumption --file <payload.json>

gotchas.text: Receipts are permanent and always kept, even over the cap.

A receipt for a job with no reservation, another attempt, an already settled job, a different currency, money above the job cap, or occurredAt after the lease expired trips the circuit breaker: the project/activity budgets (and pool) become paused and only the owner can resume.
Token-only receipts do not move money: missing money is not zero cost.
Never derive money from tokens unless the user gives the rate.

name: settle_aish_budget
purpose: Closes a finished job's financial reservation: releases the unspent remaining amount back to the project/activity budgets and the pool, keeping all consumption history.
useWhen: The owner explicitly instructs to settle a job that is completed, failed or canceled and all its consumption receipts are recorded
avoidWhen: Job is still queued, leased or running: wait
Correcting a receipt: use adjust_aish_consumption
Funding a job: use fund_aish_job
Any case without an explicit owner instruction
